name: Refrigerator Production Line Solutions
summary: A complete line automation solution for refrigerator manufacturers, covering the entire process from assembly to packaging.
contentHtml:
The refrigerator production line solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for refrigerator manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers component feeding, compressor installation, panel assembly, pipeline connection, electrical wiring, online inspection, vacuum evacuation and refrigerant charging, automatic packaging, and intelligent palletizing.

Technical Advantages

  • High level of line automation, reducing reliance on manual labor
  • Flexible switching between multiple models, improving equipment utilization
  • Online inspection system to ensure product quality
  • Automated material handling with process cycle matching
  • Intelligent data collection for lean production
  • Turnkey project service, one-stop delivery

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
